name: maya_brooks
title: Outpatient Orthopedic Physical Therapist
job_desc:
Outpatient Orthopedic Physical Therapist - Peak Motion Physical Therapy (Austin, TX)
Join a growing outpatient orthopedic and sports clinic. You will evaluate and treat a full orthopedic caseload (12-15 patients a day), including post-operative ACL, shoulder and total joint patients and athletes returning to sport.
Requirements: Texas PT license; DPT; 2+ years outpatient orthopedic experience; manual therapy and dry needling skills; experience with WebPT; strong patient education. OCS, SCS or CSCS a plus. Experience as a clinical instructor a plus. We track outcomes with FOTO.

interview.question: Tell me about a patient who was not progressing and what you did.
interview.answer: I had a knee patient who was not getting better. I changed the exercises and they got better after a few weeks.

facts: Maya sees about 14 patients a day at around 90% productivity.
Her FOTO functional outcome scores are above the national average for knee and shoulder patients.
She has been the clinical instructor for 3 DPT students.
She built a return-to-run program the clinic now uses for runners after knee injuries.
About 40% of her caseload is post-operative patients.
